name: Zhivotnyye strasti, ili o moyom p'er'erozhd'enii v govor'aschego zv'er'a posl'e n'esv'ezhego zavtraka
original_name: Животные страсти, или о моём перерождении в говорящего зверя после несвежего завтрака
source:
One not-so-fine, decidedly non-Wednesday morning, you wake up and decide to brighten your mundane existence with breakfast. But today, the open fridge door won't be your salvation from hunger - it will become a portal to a thrilling world of an intricately woven tale!

After warming up some two-day-old shawarma for breakfast, you'll pass on to the next world... I mean, to another world - where you'll turn into a talking animal and meet all your favorite characters... which is to say, other talking animals!
translation:
One not-so-fine, decidedly non-Wednesday morning, you wake up and decide to brighten your mundane existence with breakfast. But today, the open fridge door won't be your salvation from hunger - it will become a portal to a thrilling world of an intricately woven tale!

After warming up some two-day-old shawarma for breakfast, you'll pass on to the next world... I mean, to another world - where you'll turn into a talking animal and meet all your favorite characters... which is to say, other talking animals!
